mapper.select: SELECT G.JOB_GRD_CD AS RANK_ID, G.JOB_GRD_NM AS RANK_NAME, G.SORT_ORDER AS SORT_ORDER, G.USE_YN, COUNT(E.EMP_ID) AS ASSIGNED_EMPLOYEE_COUNT FROM TB_JOB_GRADE G LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON E.JOB_GRD_CD = G.JOB_GRD_CD AND NVL(E.ENABLED, 'Y') = 'Y' WHERE NVL(G.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' GROUP BY G.JOB_GRD_CD, G.JOB_GRD_NM, G.SORT_ORDER, G.USE_YN ORDER BY G.SORT_ORDER ASC, G.JOB_GRD_CD ASC
SELECT 'JOB' || LPAD( NVL(( SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TRIM(JOB_GRD_CD), 4))) FROM TB_JOB_GRADE WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(JOB_GRD_CD), '^JOB[0-9]+$') ), 0) + 1, 2, '0' ) FROM DUAL

SELECT G.JOB_GRD_CD AS RANK_ID, G.JOB_GRD_NM AS RANK_NAME, G.SORT_ORDER AS SORT_ORDER, G.USE_YN, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_EMPLOYEE E WHERE E.JOB_GRD_CD = G.JOB_GRD_CD AND NVL(E.ENABLED, 'Y') = 'Y' ) AS ASSIGNED_EMPLOYEE_COUNT FROM TB_JOB_GRADE G WHERE G.JOB_GRD_CD = #{rankId} AND NVL(G.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_JOB_GRADE ( JOB_GRD_CD, JOB_GRD_NM, SORT_ORDER, USE_YN, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{jobGrdCd}, #{jobGrdNm}, #{sortOrder}, 'Y', NVL(#{frstRgtrId}, 0), SYSDATE, NVL(#{lastMdfrId}, 0), SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_JOB_GRADE SET JOB_GRD_NM = #{rankName}, SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder}, LAST_MDFR_ID = NVL(#{lastModifierId}, 0), LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE JOB_GRD_CD = #{rankId} AND NVL(USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
UPDATE TB_JOB_GRADE SET USE_YN = 'N', LAST_MDFR_ID = NVL(#{lastModifierId}, 0), LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE JOB_GRD_CD = #{rankId} AND NVL(USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT E.EMP_ID FROM TB_EMPLOYEE E WHERE E.JOB_GRD_CD = #{rankId} AND NVL(E.ENABLED, 'Y') = 'Y'
